Rules: CURRENT SESSION ONLY: use only the session id, session folder and events.jsonl named under '## Session'. Never read or query other sessions.

usql is READ-ONLY: open session-store.db with ?mode=ro; single SELECT / FTS MATCH statements only; every query on turns, checkpoints, search_index, session_files filters by session_id = '<current session id>'; LIMIT 50.
Never write files via the shell. All document changes go through the edit/create tools inside the current session folder.

CliTools.Name: usql
CliTools.UseCase: Query session-store.db for the current session. Example: `usql "sqlite:///C:/Users/USER/.copilot/session-store.db?mode=ro" -c "select turn_index, substr(user_message,1,300) from turns where session_id='<id>' order by turn_index desc limit 20" -J`.
